blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Knowledge distillation improves a student model's reasoning ability through supervision from a teacher. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses the same model as both teacher and student under different contexts: the student generates reasoning trajectories from the question alone, while the teacher additionally receives a complete worked example and provides token-level supervision along those trajectories. Because the problem statement is shared, its content and ordering shape both student generation and teacher feedback. Preserving its semantic structure therefore seems natural, but does it always improve learning? We introduce Shuffled OPSD, which shuffles the words of the shared problem statement while keeping the teacher-only worked example intact. Across three mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three Qwen3 model scales, the method improves mean accuracy over both an intact-target control and Standard OPSD under matched training configurations. The largest gain over Standard OPSD is 3.52 percentage points on Qwen3-1.7B. Further controls show that preserving larger word blocks offers no advantage over word-level shuffling at the evaluated scales, whereas shuffling the teacher-only worked example reduces accuracy at every scale. Cross-problem mixing and target-removal experiments further distinguish the roles of problem content, word order, and teacher context. These results show that disrupting the shared problem statement can improve learning, while disrupting the teacher-only reference hurts performance. They challenge semantic coherence as a universally beneficial principle for OPSD and motivate closer study of how input structure shapes student generation and teacher supervision.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have substantially improved mathematical reasoning through post-training methods such as reinforcement learning ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , supervised fine-tuning ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Wei et al., 2021 ) , and knowledge distillation ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) .
Among these approaches, on-policy distillation combines two useful properties: the student learns on trajectories sampled from its own policy, while a teacher provides dense token-level supervision on those trajectories ( Agarwal et al., 2023 ; Gu et al., 2023 ) .
On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) further removes the need for a separate teacher model by instantiating teacher and student from the same backbone under different conditioning contexts.
The student sees the problem and generates its own response, while a frozen teacher scores the same prefixes with access to privileged context such as a worked solution.
blocks.zh:
大语言模型(LLMs)的近期进步,通过强化学习(Shao等,2024;Yu等,2025;Liu等,2025)等培训后方法,大大改善了数学推理,监督微调(Oyang等,2022;Wei等,2021;和知识分解(Zhao等,2026a).
在这些方法中,政策提炼结合了两个有用的特性:学生学习从自己的政策中抽取的轨迹,而教师则对这些轨迹进行密集的象征性监督(Agarwal等,2023;Gu等,2023)。
政策上自我消化(OPSD)(赵等,2026a)通过在不同的前提下从同一骨干中即时化师生,进一步消除了单独教师模式的必要性.
学生看到问题并产生自己的反应,而被冷冻的老师则得分相同的前缀,可以访问工作解决方案等特权背景.

blocks.en:
Most work on OPSD has focused on the privileged information available to the teacher.
Recent studies examine whether the teacher needs a correct solution, how much reasoning should be exposed, and whether useful learning persists with absent or unrelated references ( Shrestha and Tessier, 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026b ) .
These results suggest that richer or more semantically relevant teacher context does not always translate into a better trained student.
However, a separate part of the OPSD conditioning structure has received much less attention: the problem statement shared by both teacher and student is normally kept intact.
blocks.zh:
有关OPSD的大部分工作侧重于教师可获得的特权信息。
最近的研究考察了老师是否需要一个正确的解决方案,应暴露出多少推理,以及是否在缺乏参考或不相关的参考的情况下坚持有益的学习(Shrestha and Tessier, 2026;张等, 2026;沈等, 2026;李等, 2026;赵等, 2026b.).
这些结果表明,教师背景的丰富或更贴切,并不总是能转化为训练有素的学生。
然而,OPSD调制结构的一个单独部分受到的关注要少得多:师生共同的问题说明通常保存完好.

blocks.en:
The shared problem plays a different role from teacher-only privileged information.
It determines which trajectories the student generates and therefore which prefixes receive supervision.
It also conditions the student and teacher distributions used to compute the distillation loss.
Its structure thus affects both where learning occurs and what feedback the teacher provides.
This makes the shared problem a distinct design dimension: changing its structure can alter the learning process even when the teacher reference and distillation objective remain fixed.
blocks.zh:
共同的问题与教师专用信息的作用不同。
它决定学生产生什么样的轨道,因此,哪个前缀接受监管.
这也为计算蒸馏损失所使用的学生和教师分配提供了条件.
因此,其结构既影响学习的发生,也影响教师提供的反馈。
这使得共同的问题成为一个独特的设计层面:即使教师参考和分馏目标保持不变,改变其结构也能改变学习过程.

blocks.en:
We ask whether preserving the semantic structure of the shared problem improves OPSD, or whether deliberately disrupting it can produce a better student.
Destroying word order appears counterproductive for mathematical reasoning.
Yet OPSD trains through teacher feedback on student-generated trajectories, rather than directly rewarding the semantic coherence of its inputs.
A problem statement that is easier to interpret need not induce trajectories and supervision that lead to better learning.
This motivates treating the shared problem as a training interface , whose structure can differ from that of the intact problems used at inference.
blocks.zh:
我们问的是,保留共同问题的语义结构是否改善了OPSD,还是故意破坏它能产生更好的学生.
破坏词序似乎对数学推理适得其反.
然而,OPSD通过教师对学生产生的轨迹的反馈来进行训练,而不是直接奖励其投入的语义一致性.
比较容易解释的问题说明不需要诱导能导致更好学习的轨迹和监督.
这促使将共有问题视为培训接口,其结构可能不同于推论中使用的完整问题的结构。

blocks.en:
Based on this intuition, we introduce Shuffled OPSD .
We first replace the teacher’s target-associated solution with a complete worked example from an unrelated problem, forming the UnrelatedRef condition.
Across three model scales, this condition retains performance comparable to Standard OPSD, with differences in three-benchmark mean accuracy of at most 0.55 percentage points.
Building on this condition, Shuffled OPSD permutes the word order of the problem seen by both student and teacher while keeping the teacher-only reference intact.
The student generates its trajectory from the shuffled problem, and the frozen teacher provides token-level supervision under the same transformed problem together with the reference.
The transformation preserves the problem’s words, numbers, and symbolic content while disrupting their ordering.
The distillation objective remains unchanged, and evaluation always uses the original intact problems.
blocks.zh:
基于这种直觉,我们介绍Shuffled OPSD。
我们首先用一个不相干的问题的完整实例来取代老师的目标相关解决方案,形成不相关的参考条件。
在三个模型尺度中,这一条件保留了与标准OPSD相仿的性能,三个基准的平均精度差异最多为0.55个百分点.
基于这个条件,Shuffled OPSD 将学生和老师都看到的问题的词序固定下来,同时保持仅师资参考完好无损.
学生从被洗涤出的问题中产生出自己的轨迹,被冷冻的老师在同样的被改造出的问题下,与参考文献一起提供象征级的监督.
改变保留了问题的语言、数字和象征性内容,同时扰乱了他们的秩序。
蒸馏目标保持不变,评价总是使用原始的完整问题.

blocks.en:
Our experiments reveal a consistent pattern: replacing the teacher reference with an unrelated example preserves performance, shuffling the shared problem improves it, and additionally shuffling the teacher reference reduces it.
Using the final checkpoints after 50 optimizer steps, word-level shuffling improves three-benchmark mean accuracy over Standard OPSD by 3.52, 1.11, and 1.38 percentage points on Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-8B, respectively.
At 1.7B and 4B, preserving larger word blocks offers no advantage over word-level shuffling.
These results support selective semantic disruption : disrupting the shared problem’s ordering while retaining the structure of the teacher’s reference.
They extend the study of OPSD from what information the teacher receives to how the shared input is organized.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验揭示出一种一贯的规律:用一个不相干的例子来取而代之的教师参考可以保持性能,打乱共同的问题可以改善它,另外打乱教师参考可以减少它.
使用50个最优化步骤后的最终检查站,字级打分比标准OPSD提高3个基准平均精度,在Qune3-1.7B,Qune3-4B和Qune3-8B上分别提高3.52分,1.11分和1.38分.
在1.7B和4B时,保留较大的单词块比单词级的打乱没有优势.
这些结果支持选择性的语义干扰:在保留教师参考结构的同时,破坏共同问题的命令。
它们将OPSD的研究从教师得到的信息扩大到如何组织共享投入。

blocks.en:
Our contributions are as follows: First, we identify the semantic structure of the shared problem as a distinct design dimension in OPSD, affecting both student-generated trajectories and teacher supervision.
Second, we introduce Shuffled OPSD , a simple input transformation that improves reasoning performance without changing the distillation objective or inference procedure.
Third, through controlled interventions on the shared problem and teacher-only reference, we show that their semantic structures play different roles and establish selective semantic disruption as an effective input-design principle across three model scales.
blocks.zh:
我们的捐款如下: 首先,我们确定,共同问题的语义结构是OPSD中一个独特的设计层面,既影响到学生产生的轨迹,也影响到教师的监督.
第二,我们引入了Shuffled OPSD(Shuffled OPSD),这是一种简单的输入转换,在不改变分馏目标或推论程序的情况下,提高推理性能.
第三,我们通过对共同问题进行有控制的干预和仅以教师为参考,表明他们的语义结构发挥不同的作用,并确立选择性语义中断作为三个模型尺度的有效输入-设计原则.

blocks.en:
The experiments reveal a structural asymmetry in OPSD.
Semantic structure in the shared problem is not uniformly beneficial,
whereas structure in the teacher-only reference remains valuable.
The shared problem determines where supervision is collected; the
reference shapes the teacher signal at those locations.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Knowledge distillation transfers predictive distributions ( Hinton et al., 2015 ) , and generalized distillation connects teacher supervision to privileged information ( Lopez-Paz et al., 2015 ) . Same-architecture students can also benefit from distillation ( Furlanello et al., 2018 ) . Sequence-level distillation uses teacher-generated outputs ( Kim and Rush, 2016 ) , whereas GKD and MiniLLM supervise student-generated trajectories ( Agarwal et al., 2023 ; Gu et al., 2023 ) . DistiLLM variants examine response sources and loss design ( Ko et al., 2024 ; Ko et al., 2025 ) . The importance of learner-visited states also arises in interactive imitation learning ( Ross et al., 2011 ) . We study the shared input that shapes those states and their supervision.
blocks.zh: 知识分馏转移预测分布(Hinton等,2015年),并通俗分馏将教师监管与特权信息相连接(Lopez-Paz等,2015年). 同名建筑师生也可以从蒸馏中受益(Furlanello等,2018. 序列级蒸馏使用师生产出(Kim和Rush,2016年),而GKD和MiniLLM则监督学生所生出出出轨迹(Agarwal等,2023;Gu等,2023年). DistiLLM变体研究了反应源和损失设计(Ko等,2024;Ko等,2025.). 学习者访问状态的重要性也出现在互动模仿学习中(Ross等人,2011年)。 我们研究形成这些国家的共同投入及其监督。

blocks.en: Context distillation transfers context-induced behavior into model parameters ( Snell et al., 2022 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) . Related methods learn from privileged solutions ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) , demonstrations ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ) , textual feedback ( Hübotter et al., 2026 ) , or successful generated rationales ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ) . Recent OPSD studies examine reference benefits ( Shrestha and Tessier, 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , problem-space guidance ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) , trajectory-conditioned teachers ( Feng et al., 2026 ) , and pseudo-solutions ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Work on thinking degradation motivates changes to token-level supervision ( Kaur et al., 2026 ; Peng et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) . Our design complements these approaches by changing the input shared by student and teacher while retaining a fixed reference assignment.

OPSD近期的研究考察了参考效益(Shrestha and Tessier, 2026;Zhang等, 2026.),问题空间指导(Zhao等, 2026b.),有轨迹条件的教师(Feng等, 2026.),以及伪解决方案. blocks.en: Word swaps in augmentation ( Wei and Zou, 2019 ) , denoising from corrupted text ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) , shuffled-text pretraining ( Sinha et al., 2021a ) , and word-order robustness tests ( Sinha et al., 2021b ) provide precedents for disrupting text structure. Demonstration content and order also affect in-context prediction ( Min et al., 2022 ; Lu et al., 2022 ) . Shuffled OPSD uses transformed text to collect and supervise student trajectories, without reconstructing the intact target or assigning it the original answer as a label. The outcome of interest is accuracy after training, evaluated on intact problems.
blocks.zh: 增收(Wei and Zou, 2019)中的文字互换,从被腐坏的文本中去Noing(Lewis等, 2020),shuffled-text pretraining(Sinha等, 2021a),和词序强性测试(Sinha等, 2021b)为破坏文本结构提供了先例. 示范内容和秩序也影响内文预测(Min等,2022;Lu等,2022.). Shuffled OPSD使用已转换的文本来收集和监督学生的轨迹,而不重建完好的目标或者将原答案指定为标签. 兴趣的结果是经过培训后准确无误,并评价完好无损的问题。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Our results show that semantic coherence is not uniformly beneficial for OPSD. Shuffled OPSD improves reasoning by disrupting the shared problem while preserving a structured teacher-only reference, outperforming the compared conditions across three model scales without changing the distillation objective or inference procedure. The key finding is a structural asymmetry: shuffling the shared problem helps, whereas shuffling the teacher reference hurts, motivating selective semantic disruption as a design principle for OPSD—perturb the input that shapes student trajectories while preserving the structure that supports teacher guidance. More broadly, distillation inputs should be designed not only for semantic fidelity, but for the learning dynamics they induce, through both the trajectories they elicit and the supervision they enable.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,语义一致性对OPSD并不一致. Shuffled OPSD通过打破共享问题同时保留结构化的只由老师引用,在三个模型尺度的比对条件上表现优异而无需改变分馏目标或推论程序来改进推理. 关键发现是结构不对称:打乱共同的问题有帮助,而打乱教师参考会伤害,促使选择性语义中断,作为OPSD的设计原则——破坏塑造学生轨迹的输入,同时保留支持教师指导的结构。 更广泛地说,蒸馏投入不仅应设计为语义上的忠诚,而且应设计为通过它们所引出的道路和它们所促成的监督而诱发的学习动力。

The AllShuffle variants reveal the complementary effect on the
teacher-only reference.
At 1.7B, increasing the block size from 4 to 8 raises the mean from

The benefit of semantic disruption is therefore strongly
location-dependent: aggressive disruption is most effective on the
shared problem, while preserving structure in the teacher-only reference
consistently produces stronger students.

blocks.en:
Taken together, these results strengthen the central design principle of
Shuffled OPSD.
The useful signal does not come from preserving progressively more local
semantic structure in the shared problem.
Instead, performance is maximized by strongly disrupting the shared
problem while retaining a structured teacher context.
